## Summary
A brief description of the changes made and why.

## Type of Change
Analysis/scoring tooling, documentation fix, reproduction report, or something else?

> Note: everything under `scl_families/` and `scl/` is generated by the private pipeline's export and verified against `scl_families/SHA256SUMS` and `scl/PUBLIC_EXPORT.json` - PRs modifying them will not be merged. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
> Bugs in the vendored Fail2Drive harness belong [upstream](https://github.com/autonomousvision/fail2drive/issues).

## How to Test
Steps to verify the changes work as expected. For tooling, a worked example against a real family.

## Notes
For reproduction results, include the agent and checkpoint revision, CARLA version, and per-seed outcomes.
